import pandas as pd
import os

# Load beneficiaries
ben_path = '/data/beneficiaries.csv'
pay_path = '/data/payments.xlsx'

# Check files exist
print('Files exist:', os.path.exists(ben_path), os.path.exists(pay_path))

ben_df = pd.read_csv(ben_path)
print('Beneficiaries shape:', ben_df.shape)
print(ben_df.head())

# Load payments sheet Disbursements
pay_df = pd.read_excel(pay_path, sheet_name='Disbursements')
print('Payments shape:', pay_df.shape)
print(pay_df.head())

# Clean status
# Trim whitespace and lower case
pay_df['Status_clean'] = pay_df['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
# Filter paid
paid_df = pay_df[pay_df['Status_clean'] == 'paid'].copy()
print('Paid rows:', paid_df.shape[0])

# Ensure Beneficiary ID present in beneficiaries
ben_ids = set(ben_df['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip())
paid_df['Beneficiary ID_clean'] = paid_df['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
# Filter to those in ben_ids
paid_df_filtered = paid_df[paid_df['Beneficiary ID_clean'].isin(ben_ids)]
print('Paid rows with matching beneficiary:', paid_df_filtered.shape[0])

# Distinct beneficiaries with at least one paid payment
distinct_paid_bens = set(paid_df_filtered['Beneficiary ID_clean'].unique())
print('Distinct paid beneficiaries:', len(distinct_paid_bens))

total_bens = ben_df['Beneficiary ID'].nunique()
print('Total beneficiaries:', total_bens)

percentage = len(distinct_paid_bens) / total_bens * 100
print('Percentage:', percentage)
